posts.hook: A crypto wallet theft traced back to the factory
posts.caption: ledger says an $86m theft from hundreds of its wallets involved devices from a reseller and a hardware implant, amazon is reportedly in talks to buy decart, and a college cannot get flock to remove its cameras. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Ledger confirms a ==hardware implant== in wallets behind an $86M+ theft
slides.desc: The devices came from a reseller, so buying only from the maker is the lesson.

slides.title: Amazon is in talks to buy Decart for about $7B
slides.desc: Anthropic passed on it at $6B in September; the prize is easier switching between AI chips.

slides.title: A college asked Flock to remove its cameras and Flock refused
slides.desc: Elgin feared data sharing with border agents and weak security; Flock says no contract breach.

slides.title: A 177B-parameter model now runs on a 64GB Mac at 36 tokens a second
slides.desc: A community build also strips its refusals, so local models keep slipping past guardrails.

slides.title: GitHub is rewriting its storage layer for reliability before agent traffic hits
slides.desc: The old Spokes system is on its way out.

posts.hook: Microsoft wants off the Nvidia treadmill
posts.caption: microsoft unveils its third-gen in-house ai chip, cyberattacks heated french supermarket fridges to 50c for about six hours, and a viral chart on russian bot traffic probably does not show what people think. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Microsoft unveils Maia 300, its third-gen in-house AI chip
slides.desc: Production starts in 2027, with ==multi-gigawatt== rollouts planned, so inference leans less on Nvidia.

terms.gloss: running a trained AI model to answer requests

slides.title: Cyberattacks heated French supermarket fridges to 50°C for about six hours
slides.desc: Hundreds of stores threw out food; the targets were Danfoss-managed refrigeration systems.

terms.gloss: the vendor that manages the stores' refrigeration systems

slides.title: That Yandex bot-traffic chart probably does not show a troll farm going dark
slides.desc: The Verge says the drop likely reflects ordinary automated traffic, not disinformation bots.

slides.title: White House restores the UK AI Safety Institute's access to frontier models
slides.desc: A reversal: the UK institute can test the newest models again.

terms.gloss: the most capable AI models from the leading labs

slides.title: Smartphone shipments fell 20% to a 14-year Q3 low
slides.desc: Memory shortages squeezed supply; Apple still passed ==20% share== for the first time in a Q3.
